title: Toolbar attach + plugin binding; ezgrid and ezfilter on Pending builds
asked: Make the Pending builds sort row a toolbar asset 'ezgrid' and the status count buttons a toolbar asset 'ezfilter' (icon, text, corner count badge), both attached to the pending list. Toolbar asset type gains attachTo (any element: grid, chart, image...) so its actions apply to the attached element, and a plugin field so the toolbar's settings show in the plugin's settings; plugin toolbars must declare it's a plugin toolbar, which plugin and which element or they don't validate. Validated with Pydantic.
doing: Reading the toolbar asset type and the Pending builds view

steps.text: Toolbar asset type: attachTo + plugin binding, validated (schema, TS, Pydantic)
ezgrid + ezfilter assets, wired into Pending builds
